sources.title: BARTpho · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BARTpho BARTpho is a large-scale Vietnamese sequence-to-sequence model. It offers a word-based and syllable-based version. This model is built on the BART large architecture with its denoising pretraining. You can find all the original checkpoints under the VinAI organization. This model was contributed by dqnguyen.

sources.snippet: Two BARTpho versions BARTpho-syllable and BARTpho-word are the first public large-scale monolingual sequence-to-sequence models pre-trained for Vietnamese. BARTpho uses the "large" architecture and pre-training scheme of the sequence-to-sequence denoising model BART, thus especially suitable for generative NLP tasks.
